articles.title: Seraphine Champion Theme
articles.summary: Official champion theme for Seraphine, the Starry-Eyed Songstress, sung by Jasmine Clarke.

articles.title: Join the K/DA MORE TikTok Challenge
articles.summary: Riot invited fans to the #YouWantMore TikTok challenge, filming before-and-after transformations timed to the "MORE" drop and mimicking Ahri's orb push from the video, to celebrate the second single from K/DA's ALL OUT EP.

articles.title: Official Music Video: K/DA - MORE
articles.summary: Music video for K/DA's "MORE," the group's return with Seraphine, featuring Madison Beer, SOYEON and MIYEON of (G)I-DLE, Lexie Liu and Jaira Burns.

articles.title: Take Over - ford. Remix
articles.summary: A remix by ford. of "Take Over," the Worlds 2020 anthem.

articles.title: Champion Insights: Seraphine
articles.summary: Developers explain how Seraphine became a Piltover-born pop star who can hear the songs of others' souls, how she differs from her real-world K/DA persona, and how her music-based kit works on the Rift.

articles.title: Samira Champion Theme
articles.summary: Official champion theme for Samira, the Desert Rose, composed by Andrea Bellucci.

articles.title: Take Over | Worlds 2020 Music Video
articles.summary: Music video for "Take Over," the Worlds 2020 anthem featuring Jeremy McKinnon of A Day To Remember, MAX and Henry, co-written with Alex Seaver of Mako and Cal Scruby.

articles.title: PsyOps Skins Theme
articles.summary: Official skins theme for PsyOps 2020, by Riot composer Jason Walsh, shown with the skin line's splash art development.

articles.title: Official Lyric Video: K/DA - THE BADDEST
articles.summary: Lyric video for "THE BADDEST," the pre-release single that started K/DA's 2020 comeback, featuring SOYEON and MIYEON of (G)I-DLE, Bea Miller and Wolftyla.

articles.title: The Frequencies of Folklore
articles.summary: The final Spirit Blossom dev article: the sound team explains how traditional East Asian instruments, consonant versus dissonant harmonies and breathy textures were used to tell apart the kind kanmei spirits from the dangerous akana.

articles.title: Riot Music: Creator-Safe Guidelines
articles.summary: Riot Music explained why some of its songs can be used freely by streamers while others cannot: in-house themes are fully owned by Riot, but tracks co-written with outside artists and labels, such as K/DA and True Damage songs, carry shared rights. The post also covers the Creator-Safe Playlist and an FAQ.

articles.title: Yone, The Unforgotten: Champion Theme
articles.summary: Official champion theme for Yone, the Unforgotten, by the Riot Music Team.

articles.title: Lillia, The Bashful Bloom: Champion Theme
articles.summary: Official champion theme for Lillia, the Bashful Bloom, composed by Leland Cox.

articles.title: Volibear Champion Theme
articles.summary: Official champion theme for the reworked Volibear, the Relentless Storm: an Ursine war hymn composed by Austin Wintory and sung by Einar Selvik.

articles.title: JINXMIX | League of Legends Champion Remix
articles.summary: A champion remix video built around Jinx ("It's Jinx, but remixed"); the linked video is no longer available on YouTube.

articles.title: True Damage Streamer Overlay and Asset Pack
articles.summary: Released alongside Prestige True Damage Senna, a creator kit for the virtual hip-hop group: an XSplit stream overlay, cosplay references, splash and concept art, wallpapers taken from the GIANTS music video, and links to the music.

articles.title: Warriors Cinematic Season 2020 Asset Pack
articles.summary: After the Season 2020 "Warriors" remix cinematic, Riot released an asset pack with Blur Studio's 3D weapon and character models, high-res stills and concept art for fans to make cosplay and art.

articles.title: Warriors - Season 2020 Cinematic
articles.summary: Season 2020 cinematic set to a reimagined "Warriors," produced by 2WEI with vocals by Edda Hayes.

articles.title: Creating the Worlds 2019 Opening Ceremony
articles.summary: Behind the scenes of the Worlds 2019 Finals opening ceremony in Paris, produced with Mastercard.

articles.title: Official Music Video: True Damage - GIANTS
articles.summary: Debut single from True Damage, "GIANTS," first performed at Worlds 2019, featuring Becky G, Keke Palmer, SOYEON of (G)I-DLE, DUCKWRTH and Thutmose.

articles.title: Phoenix - 1788-L Remix
articles.summary: A remix of the Worlds 2019 anthem "Phoenix" by 1788-L.

articles.title: True Damage Skins Trailer
articles.summary: Skins trailer for True Damage Akali, Qiyana, Yasuo, Senna and Ekko, launching the virtual hip-hop group.

articles.title: 10 Years of Riot Music
articles.summary: A roundup for League's 10th anniversary: Riot recapped the Worlds 2019 anthem "Phoenix," announced collaborations with community musicians such as Albert Chang, TJ Brown, Nicki Taylor and Lunity, unveiled its first vinyl (26 orchestral works with iam8bit), and put more than 200 songs from its catalog on streaming services.

articles.title: 10th Anniversary Orchestral Vinyl
articles.summary: Announcement of League of Legends: Selected Orchestral Works, a 2xLP vinyl from iam8bit on red and blue smoke vinyl collecting orchestral champion, regional and esports themes for the game's 10th anniversary.

articles.title: Phoenix - Blanke Remix
articles.summary: A remix of the Worlds 2019 anthem "Phoenix" by Blanke.

articles.title: Senna Champion Theme
articles.summary: Official champion theme for Senna, the Redeemer, made by the Riot Music Team with The Crystal Method.

articles.title: Dev Doodles: K/DA
articles.summary: In this Dev Doodles episode, developers recall the challenges of creating K/DA's "POP/STARS," including choosing which style of K-pop the song should be.

articles.title: Phoenix - Carpenter Brut Remix
articles.summary: A remix of the Worlds 2019 anthem "Phoenix" by Carpenter Brut.

articles.title: /dev: Rocking on the Rift
articles.summary: Riot composer ProtoShredanoid explains how a simple guitar figure grew into the Eclipse Leona theme (adding hang drum, celeste and vocals by Lisa Thorn), and shares guitar tablature for Odyssey, Pool Party and Aatrox plus the full Snowdown 2017 score.

articles.title: /dev: Unorthodox Instruments and New Sheet Music
articles.summary: Composer Alex "Scherzo" Temple describes how the Riot music team builds instruments from found objects, such as a trash-can-and-wire percussion rig recorded for Ekko's teaser, and releases a second batch of raw session scores including Pentakill II's "Mortal Reminder" and Legendary Versus: Yasuo vs Riven.

articles.title: No one shreds like the undead
articles.summary: A pointer to Pentakill's official site, where the virtual metal band's 10-track album could be streamed and downloaded for free.

articles.title: Sheet music available now
articles.summary: Riot's music team began publishing the raw scores used at its recording sessions, starting with themes for Kled, Camille, Tahm Kench and Demacia Rising, each with notes from the composer.

articles.title: Making of “Phoenix”
articles.summary: Behind the scenes of "Phoenix" with Cailin Russo, Chrissy Costanza and the Riot Music Team.

articles.title: Watch the Worlds Music Video “Phoenix”
articles.summary: Music video for "Phoenix," the Worlds 2019 anthem featuring Cailin Russo and Chrissy Costanza, written with Alex Seaver of Mako and Stevie Aiello.

articles.title: Awaken - Season 2019 Cinematic
articles.summary: Season 2019 cinematic set to "Awaken" featuring Valerie Broussard and violinist Ray Chen, written with Alex Seaver of Mako; it first premiered in January 2019.

articles.title: Making of RISE
articles.summary: The Riot Music Team, The Glitch Mob, Mako and The Word Alive discuss making "RISE," the Worlds 2018 anthem.

articles.title: Official Music Video: K/DA - POP/STARS
articles.summary: Music video for "POP/STARS," the debut single of virtual K-pop group K/DA (Ahri, Evelynn, Kai'Sa and Akali), featuring Madison Beer, MIYEON and SOYEON of (G)I-DLE, and Jaira Burns; it was first released in November 2018.

articles.title: Worlds 2019 Orchestral Theme
articles.summary: The orchestral theme for the 2019 World Championship, composed by the Riot Music Team.

articles.title: MUTEMIX
articles.summary: A champion remix video built around Sona and Bard ("It's Sona & Bard, but remixed"); the video is no longer available on YouTube.

articles.title: YASMIX | League of Legends Champ Remix
articles.summary: A champion remix video built around Yasuo ("It's Yasuo, but remixed"); the video is no longer available on YouTube.

articles.title: Legends Never Die: Alan Walker Remix
articles.summary: Alan Walker's remix of "Legends Never Die," the Worlds 2017 anthem sung by Chrissy Costanza of Against The Current with Alex Seaver of Mako.

articles.title: Warsongs
articles.summary: Warsongs was a free-to-download collection of electronic remixes of classic League music made for the 2016 season, with remixers including Arty, Marshmello, Jauz, Vicetone, Mako and Hyper Potions; it also includes the ProtoShredanoid remix of "Silver Scrapes."
